title: It from qubit: quantum gravity is formulated in qubits

statements.text: Extending Wheeler's it from bit, quantum gravity, the theory that will reconcile quantum mechanics with general relativity, can be formulated in terms of qubits stored in space at the Planck scale.

sources.quote: The conjecture is that Quantum Gravity, the theory which will reconcile Quantum Mechanics with General Relativity, can be formulated in terms of quantum bits of information (qubits) stored in space at the Planck scale
